basic_profile.bio: Avid Pokémon fan and dedicated trader based in the Pacific Northwest. I've been collecting and trading Pokémon since the early days of Red and Blue. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to schedule my trades throughout the day. Usually online during late afternoons and evenings. I'm single and enjoy exploring the outdoors when not glued to my Nintendo Switch. Not a big fan of early mornings or overly complicated trade negotiations.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Extensive knowledge of Pokémon games, especially in breeding and trading rare Pokémon. I have honed my skills through years of playing and participating in online communities. I also have a solid understanding of graphic design principles, thanks to a degree in Visual Communication.
